question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (SpaceX)

calls.reasoning: SpaceX reports Q3 2026 on Oct 20 (before the Nov 3 resolution date), so it resolves. Q2 GAAP diluted EPS was -0.09 on a $541M net loss, beating a -0.26 consensus. Q3 adds a full quarter of Anthropic's ~$1.25B/month compute fee and interest income on ~$100B of cash; revenue is expected near $12.9B, but that figure may be a Netflix mix-up. Consensus estimates are about +0.13 to +0.14 with a range of 0.00 to 0.23. Against that, depreciation from the huge AI capex keeps rising and the AI segment is still loss-making, so a loss remains plausible. Q3 should use the full post-IPO share count (~13B+), which shrinks EPS for a given profit. No Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi market found.

- The Q3 2026 report and webcast are set for Oct 20, 2026, after the close (Tesla North, 247wallst, 2026-10-16). This is before the Nov 3 scheduled resolution, so it resolves rather than annuls.
- Q2 2026 (reported Aug 4): revenue $7.81B (+92% YoY), GAAP net loss $541M (vs $1.0B a year earlier), diluted EPS -$0.09 (vs -$0.34 a year earlier), adjusted EBITDA $3.5B, operating margin -1.8%, capex $18.37B ($15.83B of it AI), cash ~$100B, plus a $25B bond issue (StockTitan). Q2 consensus had been -$0.26, so it beat by $0.17 (CNBC/IndMoney search snippets).
- Q1 2026 diluted EPS -$1.27 (MarketBeat).
- -$541M / -$0.09 implies ~6.0B Q2 weighted shares (a pre-IPO partial quarter). Q3 is the first full post-IPO quarter, so expect a much higher count, around 13B+, which shrinks EPS for any given net income.
- Q2 AI segment: revenue $2.56B, operating loss $1.257B. xAI reportedly lost $6B in 2025 and $2.5B in Q1 2026 (search snippets).
- Q3 drivers (Motley Fool, 2026-10-02): first full quarter of Anthropic's ~$1.25B/month compute fee (~$3.75B for the quarter vs $1.6B Q2 cloud revenue). Google's $920M/month payments start in October, after the Q3 window. Starlink ARPU expected at $66+; Falcon launches expected above 41 per quarter (37 in Q2).
- Q3 revenue forecasts cite ~$12.9B (TokenPost, Coingape). Caveat: the identical $12.89B appears as Netflix's estimate in the same Mint week-ahead article, so it may be conflated.
- EPS estimates: Coingape says $0.14-$0.23. A search snippet gives a $0.13 consensus from 30 analysts (aggregator unverified). MarketBeat lists 1 analyst at $0.00. Goldman's FY2026 EPS estimate is $1.30 (Yahoo), which looks inconsistent with H1 losses unless it uses a different basis.
- Against: rising depreciation from more than $23B of H1 capex, AI segment losses, new bond interest expense, possible stock-comp charges after the IPO. For: interest income on ~$100B cash (~$1B/quarter), high-margin compute fees, Starlink growth.
- Status quo: Q2 loss of -$0.09. The trend runs from deep losses toward breakeven or profit.
- Resolves off GAAP diluted EPS in the initial Q3 release (8-K/IR), not adjusted figures.
- Event window: Oct 1, 2026 -> first quarterly release (Oct 20); as of Oct 17, the release has not happened yet.
- Searched without finding: a verified multi-analyst Q3 EPS consensus from a primary aggregator, company Q3 EPS guidance, and the Q3 diluted share count. No Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi market found.
